description: DeepEval metric configuration for ecommerce Text2SQL evaluation.

metrics.name: SQL Execution Accuracy
metrics.description: Compares generated SQL result rows with rows from the gold SQL.

metrics.name: Schema Adherence
metrics.description: Checks that generated SQL is read-only and valid against the database schema.

metrics.name: Answer Correctness
metrics.description: Scores whether the final answer matches the expected facts and claims.

metrics.name: Answer Faithfulness
metrics.description: Scores whether final-answer claims are supported by executed SQL rows.

metrics.name: Contextual Relevancy
metrics.description: Scores whether retrieved schema context is relevant to the question.
